sourceCitations.purpose: Header, global/event encoding, state and validators
Signed numeric and floating byte writers
Intrinsic Function.prototype.apply.call invocation recognized by current analyzer; callback semantics are outside WAM acceptance

oracle: Literal independent header/record byte fixtures; signed little-endian integer vectors; IEEE754 1.5 and standard UTF-8 Unicode bytes. Admission expectations characterize real coercion and error behavior. No vendor source or captured telemetry included.

gateScope.reason: All nine selected modules complete supported AST analysis with no gate reads or unresolved diagnostics. The former fb-error intrinsic-call false positive is removed. Existing single-context execution is historical; callers, variants, external assignment and delivery paths remain excluded.

exclusions: WAWam manager, channel manager, storage, batching, sampling and Falco
Schema catalog compatibility and generated event emitters

Telemetry network delivery or account behavior
